description:
We are Team sphot, six students from Sungkyunkwan University, South Korea. We share a curiosity about space and a love of building things people can use.

Our skills:

Data analysis: real SPHEREx data

Backend design: sky patches on demand

Frontend development: web app and 3D sky

UI/UX design: simple, fun labeling

Our goal is to make NASA’s open SPHEREx data easy and fun for anyone to explore, so volunteers can spot what moved and help find new objects.
